policies.title: Other foreign ordinary passports: Haiti visa-free tourist entry
policies.summary: The Embassy’s live tourist-visa page says tourists generally do not need a visa, then directly names nine nationality exceptions. This policy covers every other foreign ordinary passport in the catalog. The stated USD 10 airport fee is not visa-on-arrival or electronic issuance.
conditions: Applies only to tourist visits on an ordinary passport, excluding the nine nationalities named in the Embassy’s advance-visa exception list. The Embassy says the passport must be valid for at least six months.
The Embassy says a USD 10 fee is payable on arrival at the airport, while expressly saying no visa is needed. This fee is not normalized as visa-on-arrival.
DIE’s 2026 IKAT is a digital embarkation/debarkation declaration, not electronic visa issuance, an ETA, or evidence of a visa requirement. The source does not state one uniform visa-free duration.

Final admission and rules for work, residence, transit, diplomatic or official passports, special documents, public health, security, and any nationality-specific prohibitions are outside this tourist ordinary-passport classification.

policies.title: Nine named foreign ordinary passports: Haiti tourist advance visa
policies.summary: The Embassy directly names these nine nationalities as requiring a visa to enter Haiti and says they must apply at least one month before departure. The cited process is consular advance processing, not an eVisa or visa on arrival.
conditions: Applies to tourist travel on an ordinary passport. The Embassy says applicants must apply for a visa at least one month before departure and that the passport must be valid for at least six months.

The direct three-language exception list includes Yemen. A later parenthetical sentence calls the cohort nine countries but inadvertently omits Yemen; the direct repeated named exception list controls, and this should be rechecked when Haiti publishes a dated schedule.
This classification does not establish a uniform stay duration or address work, residence, transit, diplomatic or official passports, special documents, public health, security, or final admission.

policies.title: Haitian citizen ordinary passport: home entry
policies.summary: DIE states that the Government issues a Haitian passport to its nationals after proof of Haitian citizenship. This supports the catalog’s Haitian-citizenship home-entry classification, not a foreign-visitor visa rule.
conditions: Applies only to a Haitian national travelling on a Haitian ordinary passport. Citizenship, identity-document, carrier and border-admission requirements remain governed by Haitian law and practice.
